name: @lars-hagen/mcp-playwright-cdp
description: Model Context Protocol server for Playwright with Chrome DevTools Protocol support
author: Lars Hagen

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const { chmodSync, readdirSync } = require('node:fs'); for (const file of readdirSync('dist')) if (file.endsWith('.js')) chmodSync('dist/' + file, 0o755);"
scripts.test: node tests/test.js && node tests/stdio-initialize.js node dist/index.js
